title: Navisworks Clash Matrix Governed Fields

entries.name: Test identity and naming
entries.requirement: Each governed clash test shall have a stable identity and naming basis that distinguishes it within the matrix profile.

entries.name: Model and set scope
entries.requirement: Each governed clash test shall identify the source model sets or governed selection/search sets participating in the test.

entries.name: Check type
entries.requirement: Each governed clash test shall identify its clash/check classification using the applicable coordination check-type registry.

entries.name: Tolerance basis
entries.requirement: Each governed clash test shall identify the applicable project/BEP tolerance or clearance basis; this registry does not create enterprise numeric defaults.

entries.name: Priority or criticality
entries.requirement: Each governed clash test or resulting review scope shall carry the applicable priority/criticality basis needed for routing and review.

entries.name: Grouping and deduplication basis
entries.requirement: The matrix/profile shall define or reference the grouping and deduplication logic used to prepare repeatable review results.

entries.name: Matrix profile and version
entries.requirement: Clash results used as governed evidence shall identify the matrix profile and version or equivalent configuration basis that produced them.

entries.name: Coordination cycle
entries.requirement: Clash results and downstream issues shall be traceable to the coordination cycle or review event in which the test was executed.

entries.name: Responsibility and routing basis
entries.requirement: Actionable findings shall be routable to an identifiable responsible party under the governed issue lifecycle; Navisworks itself does not create role authority.

entries.name: Approved deviation record
entries.requirement: Project-specific additions, suppressions, or deviations from the governed matrix/profile shall be traceable to the applicable approval and rationale.

matrix_governance.selection: Use the applicable project-approved clash matrix/profile for the declared coordination scope.
matrix_governance.modification_authority: Project-specific matrix modifications or extensions require the Coordination Lead or delegated authority defined by the project governance/RACI.
matrix_governance.tool_authority_boundary: Navisworks is a coordination and analysis tool; clash-test execution does not create design, fabrication, issue-approval, or acceptance authority.
matrix_governance.evidence_rule: Where clash completeness or coordination sign-off relies on the matrix, the matrix/profile version and test execution context shall be retained as traceable evidence.

non_promoted_source_content: No specific discipline-pair matrix rows are invented where the source does not provide a complete approved matrix.
No enterprise numeric hard-clash or soft-clearance tolerances are created; values remain project/BEP data.
No project-specific ignore/suppression set is promoted without an approved project basis.

provenance.source_title: S5 – Navisworks Clash Detection Matrix – Standard Setup
provenance.migration_note: Migrated the source's governed matrix/profile metadata, authority boundary, traceability and evidence requirements. Exact project test pairs and numeric tolerances were not invented.
